title: Rockstar Games Union Vote Set for GTA6 Release Window
description: Rockstar Games employees have locked in a union vote date during the GTA6 release window. It could become the UK industry's largest recognised union.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Games Union Vote Set for GTA6 Release Window

According to a recent report by Eurogamer, a definitive date has been locked in for Rockstar Games employees to vote on whether to officially recognise their developer union. Notably, this crucial vote is set to take place over the release window of the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto 6.

### A Historic Milestone for the UK Gaming Industry

If the upcoming vote is successful, the newly recognised body will officially become the largest recognised union across the entirety of the UK video games industry. This development highlights ongoing discussions regarding labour rights, workplace conditions, and developer representation within major AAA studios.

### Timing Coincides with GTA6's Launch Period

The scheduling of the union vote during the GTA6 release window has drawn significant attention from industry watchers. While official communications from the studio remain focused on development, the convergence of a major game launch window and a historic union vote creates a unique context for the studio's workforce as they determine their collective future.

## Editor's Take

As the industry counts down toward the GTA6 release window, the timing of Rockstar Games' union vote adds an unexpected layer of internal dynamics to the studio. Balancing major game production with labour milestones is no small feat, and the outcome of this vote could leave a lasting impact on the broader gaming landscape.
